posts.body: Is there a way to put an icon over a character or event to indicate that a quest is available? And when the quest is completed remove or change the icon? thanks, I use rpg maker mz and I have the visustella plugins.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
Mog Hunter has a plugin for it nicely.
another way is using balloon (in moveroute) when talking, you can
set a selfswitch, when activated, a new page.
but I would go for Mog Hunter, but I don't know the name of the plugin,
as it can be used for many balloon over head for this kind of thing.
